Archivi digitali di Framework Archaeolog: Framework Archaeology digital archives as downloaded: plan of the interventions (Stansted.shp or «T5 Volume 2.shp»), ContextData.csv and the other CSV tables, the terrain model. The units have no levels: cuts go down by the recorded depth from the excavation surface, derived from the terrain lowered by 30 cm (ploughsoil) or, for Heathrow, from the 1943 topography plus the truncation model. Fills take the polygon of their intervention. At Heathrow the spot heights (DPs.shp, level in ZCOORD) give the excavation surface where the truncation model does not reach. Filtering by site is advisable: SITECODE for the plan of the interventions and SiteCode for DPs (two filters, one per layer: the column names differ; in DPs some sites have several values, e.g. «TEC05» and «TEC05 Phase1»).
